lines: Use: Returns you to Hearthstone Location. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.
Use: Wakes up a targeted sleeping peon. (5 Sec Cooldown)
Chance on hit: Venom Shot the target for 23 to 33 Nature damage.
Chance on hit: Wounds the target for 14 Physical damage.
Equip: Improves your chance to hit by 0.3%.
Equip: Improves your chance to hit by 0.3%.
Chance on hit: Wounds the target for 42 damage. Naga are Stunned for 2 sec.
Chance on hit: Launch a magic severing bolt at the target, dealing 36 Physical damage and interrupting the spell being cast for 5 sec.
Chance on hit: Strike your ranged target with a Fire Blast for 22 to 34 Fire damage.
Chance on hit: Strike your target with Keeper's Sting for 23 to 33 Nature damage.
Chance on hit: Fires a Shadow Shot at the target for 21 to 31 Shadow damage.
Equip: Improves your chance to hit by 0.9%.
Equip: Improves your chance to hit by 0.5%.
Use: Unfurl a sleeping bag. Resting inside for at least one minute will provide a bonus to experience earned, stacking up to 3 times. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Eat a handful and make up for lost time on the trail! (5 Min Cooldown)
Use: Increases run speed by 50% for 15 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)
Equip: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 10.
"Equipping this badge is an indication of service to the Argent Dawn."
Use: Attaches a permanent scope to a bow or gun that increases its damage by 7.
Use: Teaches you how to be an Expert Cook, allowing a maximum of 225 cooking skill.
"Jingles loudly from the sound of gold and useful goods inside."
Use: Increases Agility by 25 and chance to get a critical hit by 2%. Lasts for 30 min. (3 Sec Cooldown)

Use: Restores 2065 health over 30 sec. Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 sec eating, you will become well fed and gain 1% Critical Strike chance for 15 min. Additionally, experience gained from kills is increased by 5%.
Requires Ranged WeaponAutomatically shoots the target until cancelled.
Requires Melee WeaponA strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 70.
Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Requires Ranged WeaponStings the target, causing 675 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Requires Ranged WeaponAn instant shot that causes 280 Arcane damage.

Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 98. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.
Requires Ranged WeaponDazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.
The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 120. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.
Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.
Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.
Lets you train your pet with various abilities that you have learned how to teach.
Requires Cat FormShows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.
Heals your pet 20 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.
Requires Melee WeaponInflicts 5 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.
Requires Ranged WeaponDistract the target, causing threat.
Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.
Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.
Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.
Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 57. Can only be performed after you dodge.
Requires Ranged WeaponFires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.
Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Requires Ranged WeaponAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.
The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Place a frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.
Requires Melee WeaponAttempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. More effective than Disengage (Rank 2). Disables auto-attack.
Requires Ranged WeaponStings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.
Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.
Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.
Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min. If not cancelled, after 6 min you will actually die.
The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 50. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.
Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 208 to 264 Fire damage and 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
Requires Ranged WeaponStings the target, draining 1108 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Requires Ranged WeaponContinuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 70 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.
Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 60. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Requires Ranged WeaponAttempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.
Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.
Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.
Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
Claw the enemy, causing 12 to 16 damage.
Bite the enemy, causing 31 to 37 damage.
Increases movement speed by 40% for 15 sec.
Increases movement speed by 40% for 15 sec.
Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.
The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 15 yards by 84. Lasts 1 min.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
- Escort Gizelton Caravan past Mannoroc Coven
Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe, then return to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.
Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.
10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!
20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!
Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.
Artisan skill in skinning the hides from beasts for use in Leatherworking. Gives a potential skinning skill of 300. Requires a Skinning Knife.
Allows a leatherworker to make high quality leather armors, up to a maximum potential skill of 225.
Allows a cook to make amazing recipes up to a maximum potential skill of 300.
Allows a physician to make and use bandages up to a potential skill of 225. The cloth used to make those bandages are found on humanoids in the world.

Equip a fishing pole and find a body of water to fish. Right-Click on the bob in the water when it splashes to catch your fish. Higher skill increases your chance of fishing successfully in higher level areas.
Allows an engineer to make bombs and gizmos that are truly amazing up to a maximum potential skill of 300.
Raising mining to an art form. Gives a potential mining skill of 300.

Use: Builds a basic campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 3 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features. (5 Min Cooldown)
Use: Builds a tent that allows you and others sitting nearby to increase Rested experience to 5% of a level. No effect if Rested experience already exceeds that value.
Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Assembles a camp chair that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2% increased critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, mutually exclusive with Moonkin Aura.
Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Unpacks a first aid kit that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain [(60 (1 Hour Cooldown)
Allows you to ride basic ground mounts that require a riding skill of 75.
Allows you to ride swift ground mounts that require a riding skill of 150.

While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.
Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.
Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.
Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.
Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.
Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.
Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 20%.

Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing [32 / Ferocity: 48 / Unleashed Fury: 52 + (Ranged Attack Power * (0.05))] Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 1 Rage or Energy.
Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.
Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 100% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.
Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.
Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.
Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.
Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.
Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.
You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.
Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.
Gives your Concussive Shot a 0% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.
Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.
Requires Ranged WeaponA short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.
Requires Ranged WeaponIncreases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.
Requires Ranged WeaponA long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.
When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.
Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.
When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

Requires Melee WeaponA strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar at Razor Hill.
Speak with Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar.
Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
